items.title: Abstract Overlapping Square Geometric Matrix Panel for Laser Cut
items.description: A stunning contemporary vector template displaying a dense matrix of overlapping squares and geometric abstract shapes. This modern pattern is delivered in clean DXF, SVG, and DWG cutting formats, offering a dynamic visual depth and an excellent structural balance for architectural use. Perfectly suited for manufacturing high-privacy office room dividers, minimalist garden screens, and decorative ceiling panels using high-speed laser cutting or MDF milling.
